name: TMDB Box Sets
description: Groups movies by the TMDB collection ID that Jellyfin's own metadata refresh already stores on each movie, then creates and maintains a matching box set. Requires no TMDB API key of its own: the box set is tagged with the TMDB collection ID so Jellyfin's built-in provider supplies the name, overview and artwork.
overview: Automatically group movies into box sets by their TMDB collection.
